blocks.en: Let $D$ be the unit disk in the plane and let $\Omega=D\backslash\{0\}$. It is well-known that the Dirichlet problem $\Delta u=1$ with $u=0$ on $\partial\Omega$ has no classical solution. What is the weak ``solution\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ given by Theorem~\ref{thm:weak-dirichlet-positive-shift-existence}? Hint: First characterize $H_0^1(\Omega)$.
blocks.zh: 设 $D$ 为平面中的单位圆盘, 令 $\Omega=D\backslash\{0\}$. 众所周知, Dirichlet 问题 $\Delta u=1$, 且 $\partial\Omega$ 上 $u=0$, 没有经典解. Theorem~\ref{thm:weak-dirichlet-positive-shift-existence} 给出的弱 ``解\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ 是什么? Hint: 首先刻画 $H_0^1(\Omega)$.
blocks.label: ex:punctured-disk-dirichlet-weak-solution

blocks.en: Consider the ODE boundary-value problem $y''+p(x)y'+q(x)y=f(x)$, $y(0)=y(1)=0$. Here $p\in C^1[0,1]$, $q\in C[0,1]$. Prove that a unique solution exists if $p'-2q\geq0$.
blocks.zh: 考虑 ODE 边值问题 $y''+p(x)y'+q(x)y=f(x)$, $y(0)=y(1)=0$. 这里 $p\in C^1[0,1]$, $q\in C[0,1]$. 证明, 若 $p'-2q\geq0$, 则存在唯一解.
blocks.label: ex:ode-coercive-dirichlet-uniqueness

blocks.en: Consider a ``weak\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ solution of the Dirichlet problem for the differential operator defined in \eqref{eq:second-order-garding-divergence-operator} in a situation where the coefficients $a_{ij}$, $b_i$ and $c$ have discontinuities across a smooth surface. Assume you know that the solution is smooth on both sides of this interface. Determine the ``matching conditions\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ which are satisfied across the interface.
blocks.zh: 考虑 \eqref{eq:second-order-garding-divergence-operator} 中定义的微分算子的 Dirichlet 问题的一个 ``弱\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ 解, 其中系数 $a_{ij}$, $b_i$ 和 $c$ 跨某光滑曲面间断. 假设已知解在该界面的两侧均光滑. 确定跨界面满足的 ``匹配条件\textquotesingle\textquotesingle.
